label: Cursor
notes: Cursor reads .cursor/skills/ and .agents/skills/ (plus .claude/skills/ and .codex/skills/ for compatibility). Project rules (.cursor/rules/*.mdc) are not needed when skills load natively.
caveats: Docs were read through a summarizing web fetch, not verbatim; re-check before quoting.
If Claude Code is installed too, this agent may also read .claude/skills/ and list the skill twice.
